name: 教材動画の章とサムネイル一覧
prompt:

Keep its exact 1041 × 1510 canvas, composition, Japanese text, typography, chapter order, row positions, gray selected row, slate share/repeat icons, thumbnail artwork, photo crops and embedded WSJ Tech Things wordmark unchanged. Reference 2 is only for protecting the source photographs, crops and wordmark.

Make exactly one correction: remove the pale mint capsule/background behind 0:00. Render 0:00 as plain #1F6444 text directly on the neutral-gray selected row, matching the treatment of the other green timestamps. Keep the selected row neutral gray, not green. Do not change any other fill, color, position, scale, text, glyph or image. Do not redraw or retouch the thumbnail photos.
reviewNotes: Selected attempt 2 after opening both attempts at original pixels and normalizing to the 390x565 review size. It removes the pale-mint 0:00 capsule and preserves the Japanese chapter copy, neutral-gray selected first row, share/repeat controls, green time labels, and fifth-row viewport clipping. Keep needs-correction; source and native files are unchanged.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
